primary_question: Does the observable model interpretation state the same underlying user goal, independent of CPC and terminal route?

primary_outcomes.speech_act_accuracy: Exact match of structured speech_act against frozen closed-class intent label.
primary_outcomes.semantic_goal_correctness: All five prediction-blind semantic-goal checklist items pass.

semantic_goal_correct_rule: logical AND of all five checks
diagnostic_component_score: sum(checks)/5; descriptive only, not assumed interval-calibrated
gold_references: Two independent pre-T39 historical intent_text annotations per Pilot record.
candidate_evidence: Gold-independent cleaned observable T39 raw trace with exact source-command repetitions omitted.
judge_design: Two independent prediction-blind judges; field-wise agreement and Cohen kappa; blind adjudication of disagreements.

automatic_diagnostics.sentence_embedding_cosine: continuous convergent diagnostic only; no primary correctness threshold
automatic_diagnostics.bidirectional_nli: continuous mutual-entailment diagnostic only; no primary correctness threshold

inference.paired_full_context_vs_blind: exact McNemar on binary correctness plus paired bootstrap accuracy-difference interval

important_limit: Frozen T39 did not request structured intent_summary; semantic-goal correctness measures observable stated interpretation evidence, not hidden internal reasoning.
